stage: Stage 1 · the skeleton, with every eval
title: The compiler
summary: Architect can now read a project's blueprint by its folders and files and describe it: every thing, operation, refusal, role and step, named only by where it lives. Rename a file and the operation is renamed; reformat a file and nothing changes. A new command, architect model, prints it. Capturing the evidence caught a bug the tests had missed: --json was required on the real command line. Fixed, and now tested from a real process.
proves: architect model --json on acme matches its snapshot. Renaming verbs/grant.ts to award.ts renames the operation. Reformatting a file leaves the hash unchanged.

captions.01-compiler-and-cli-tests: The compiler's and the CLI's tests, including the snapshot, rename and reformat checks.
captions.02-architect-model-on-acme: architect model on acme: three things, two operations, each with its refusals and hash.
captions.03-architect-model-json: The whole model as JSON, the one description every generator will read.
captions.04-rename-grant-to-award: A copy of acme with grant.ts renamed to award.ts. The operation is now allowance.award.
captions.05-reformatted-grant-same-hashes: A copy with grant.ts re-indented on every line. Same model, same hashes.
captions.06-planted-verb-without-operation: Planted: a verb file that holds no operation. Refused with every problem listed, exit 2.
captions.07-all-checks-green: Lint, typecheck and test across all 14 projects, cache off.
